fetch_groups.extract: Under "VOTED BALLOTS RECEIVED" open the two newest 2026 General Election PDFs (drop box and USPS). Record DC.early_total as a calc (op sum) with two parts. For EACH part: "label" and "heading" = the table heading exactly as printed (e.g. "Ballots Received by Drop Box/Ward", "BALLOTS RECEIVED BY USPS"); "value" = that table's TOTAL row, TOTAL column; "evidence" = the TOTAL row verbatim; "rows" = EVERY dated row of that table as {"label": "<the date exactly as printed>", "value": <that row's TOTAL column>, "evidence": "<the row verbatim>"}. The script checks that the rows add up to TOTAL and that data_as_of is the last date with ballots in BOTH tables, so set data_as_of to that date and as_of_evidence to that date row. metric_label = "Ballots Received"; label_evidence = both headings verbatim; election = the title line (e.g. "2026 General Election"). Ignore dates in file names. Do not add the in-person early vote item. If either table cannot be read completely, record no figure (status "error" with the reason).
